messages:
Priya: Heads-up  partner asked for a minimal Terraform module example for the refkit marketplace listing. Should be tiny and copy-pasteable.
Jon: We should include module usage + expected outputs only, not the full module source. Keeps it simple for partners.
Lena: Agreed. Also add a note about immutable container tags and a sample manifest.json entry.
Marco: I'll add a spot/reserved mix example and a short autoscale policy. Example snippet to use:
```
module "refkit_deploy" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit-terraform//modules/partner-deploy?ref=v0.1.0"
  region = "eu-west-1"
  refkit_vpc_id = "vpc-1234abcd"
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:key/abcd"
}
```
Priya: Perfect. Ops-bot can we add a reminder for packaging cutoff?
ops-bot: Reminder posted: packaging window closes 2026-05-03 23:59 UTC. Please submit artifacts 48h prior.
Jon: Also include a tiny smoke test command in the quickstart: `curl -s -X POST https://partner.example/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` and expected HTTP 200 + small JSON.
Lena: I'll write the partner checklist: account roles, KMS setup, image pinning, manifest, smoke test pass criteria. Short bullets only.
Marco: I'll PR the autoscale + cost bullets by EOD tomorrow. Priya: Can you coordinate packaging submission with partner success?
Priya: Yep, I'll handle packaging coordination. Final: PRs into the draft doc by Thu noon, internal review Thu pm. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
